m.x: Quadratic ease-in/out. Applies a quadratic curve that accelerates in the first half of the range and decelerates in the second half, producing a smooth S-curve transition. Useful for animations that need to start gently, move briskly through the middle, and settle smoothly at the end.

p.x: The value to be eased, in the range [0, 1].

r.x: The eased value, in the range [0, 1].
